question: What claim of transmission is being made when it is stated that this practice of the soul has been told to a particular person addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: A demonstrative refers to the practice of the soul.
That practice is said to have been told.
The recipient is addressed as Bhairavī and indicated by the dative.
inference: The practice of the soul has been transmitted to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full details of that practice are not given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
